name: The Last Coin Is Not Yours

system.flavor:
When someone breaks a mark you laid, scuffs the circle, tears down the charm, snuffs the candle, the breaking costs them: they sicken, go slow, lose the thread of what they were doing. The mark stays broken.

Not enough to kill or restore what they ruined.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: The enemy ends one of your Rites with an Action. Response: On success, deal 2 Necrotic Damage after that Action; the Rite remains ended.

surges.html: On a hit, suppress one ordinary magical Movement bonus on the enemy until the start of your next turn, up to 1 unit.
On a hit, it is Distracted until the start of your next turn.
